  • Bachelor of Science - Education - Subject Endorsement in Physical Education (Grades 7-12)

Bachelor of Science - Education - Subject Endorsement in Physical Education (Grades 7-12)

A student must complete the following program in addition to the Essential Studies and Professional Education Requirements for a Secondary Endorsement. This includes completion of required Health Education and/or Physical Education exit exam.

Course List
Code Title Credits
Essential Studies
Professional Education Requirements
Core Requirements
HPEHP 122FOUNDATIONS OF HEALTH AND PHYSICAL EDUCATION1
HPEHP 232APPLIED EXERCISE PHYSIOLOGY 3
HPEHP 250RHYTHMIC MOVEMENT3
HPEHP 325TEACHING FUNDAMENTAL SPORTS SKILLS3
HPEHP 332SAFETY AND FIRST AID3
HPEHP 422INTRODUCTION TO ADAPTED PHYSICAL EDUCATION3
HPEHP 429MOTOR MOVEMENT3
HPEHP 435CURRICULUM AND ASSESSMENT IN PHYSICAL EDUCATION3
HPEHP 436ADVENTURE BASED LEARNING3
HPEHP 439BIOMECHANICS OF SPORTS3
HPEHP 442AQUATICS AND WATER SAFETY3
HPEHP 456ESSENTIALS OF STRENGTH AND CONDITIONING3
or HPEHP 430 SEMINAR IN HPEHP
Total Credits34
1

Requires a Prerequisite.
